questions.title: Struct vs Union Memory
questions.description: What is the key memory layout difference between a struct and a union in C?
questions.Option1: A union's members share the same memory location; a struct's members each occupy their own storage
questions.Option2: A struct's members share the same memory; a union's members each occupy their own storage
questions.Option3: A union cannot contain int members
questions.Option4: A struct can only contain pointer members

questions.title: Pass Struct by Value Semantics
questions.description: When you pass a struct to a function by value in C, what happens to modifications made inside the function?
questions.Option1: The struct is copied; modifications do not affect the caller's original
questions.Option2: The struct is passed by reference; modifications affect the caller's original
questions.Option3: A pointer is implicitly passed alongside the struct
questions.Option4: It is undefined behavior in C

questions.title: Sizeof Struct Result
questions.description: What does sizeof(struct Point) return for a struct with two int members (assuming int is 4 bytes)?
questions.Option1: The total bytes used by the struct, possibly including padding
questions.Option2: Always exactly 4 bytes regardless of members

questions.title: Dot vs Arrow Distinction
questions.description: What is the difference between the . and -> operators in C?
questions.Option1: . is used with direct struct values; -> is used with pointers to structs
questions.Option2: -> is used with direct struct values; . is used with pointers to structs
questions.Option3: There is no difference; they are interchangeable
questions.Option4: . is for unions and -> is for structs
